subject: Run retained circle victims with the replacement strike before its action point
description: Old schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_SuN1Sh1nE/Profile_004/Savegame_032/replay-012-session-0001.jsonl.zst` formerly exhausted its recorded RNG after frame 1397. Soldier197 had retained strike-H circle geometry and PC246 in its victim list while replacement strike I was still before its action point; Rust's interruption guard returned without running the retained effect, omitting the two `ReceiveSwordDamage` protection rolls and the later provoke roll that Original consumed. Original `ExecuteCircleSwordStrike` invokes `ExecuteFullCircleSwordStrikeEffect(motionState, swordStrike)` with the current Execute call's strike before its only `IsActionDone`-gated tail-angle update (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:9886-9970`); the effect tests and removes the human-owned retained victims using that current strike's payload and direction (`original-code/RHelementactorhuman.cpp:9247-9380`). Commit `ddabda8ef0379f9f9b67ce144dc390ca31ab5dd8` therefore rebinds retained effect metadata to replacement I and runs an effect-only pass whenever a retained circle is `IN_PROGRESS` and off the replacement order's exact action-done frame and counter. That pass can enqueue damage and remove reached victims, but does not rotate the sprite or advance the current or final sweep geometry; the ordinary exact-action-point path retains its existing tail update. The H-retained/I-replacement regression covers two successive pre-action calls plus the zero-forecast-but-not-exact boundary, proves I's right-to-left victim selection and damage payload, and verifies unchanged initial/current/final angles and sprite facing. The focused `interrupted_` set passes 6/6, formatting and diff checks pass, and a freshly rebuilt optimized runner matches every recorded frame through exact EOF for the representative and nearby same-save replay-011. Same-save replay-007 is explicitly not a control: on the current tree it independently diverges after frame 331 in Soldier197 detection, visibility, and direction state, well before the historical interrupted-circle boundary.
